footer.tagline: Marketplace, IoT monitoring, and smart data for fairer, more productive farming in Angola.

hero.description: AgriLink connects farmers directly to buyers, monitors their farms with IoT sensors, and uses data to recommend the best time to irrigate, harvest, and sell.
hero.recommendationText: Soil moisture is adequate — no need to irrigate in the next 24h.

features.title: A complete ecosystem, not just a tool
features.subtitle: Unlike solutions that solve only one part of the problem, AgriLink integrates sales, monitoring, and data intelligence into a single accessible platform.
features.marketplaceDescription: Sell directly to buyers, distributors, and consumers, with no middlemen.
features.iotDescription: Low-cost sensors measure soil moisture, temperature, water level, and environmental conditions in real time.
features.aiDescription: The platform analyzes the collected data and suggests when to irrigate, warns of risks, and forecasts production.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Everything in a single system — from sensing to sale.
howItWorks.step1Description: Low-cost IoT equipment is placed on the farmer's land.
howItWorks.step2Description: Moisture, temperature, and water readings arrive in real time.
howItWorks.step3Description: Algorithms analyze the data and cross-reference it with the farm's history.
howItWorks.step4Description: Irrigation alerts and production forecasts reach the farmer's phone.
howItWorks.step5Description: The harvest is listed and sold directly to buyers.

impact.title: Real impact on the agricultural value chain
impact.subtitle: We're starting in Angola, expanding to the Republic of the Congo, the DR Congo, and China.
